_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: record_book_time
data.sql: CREATE INDEX record_book_time ON record (account_book_id, record_time DESC)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_book" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cover" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "start_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "create_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "display_way" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "extra_info" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "balance_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sub_type" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "create_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "remark" TEXT NULL, "init_money_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "is_effective_asset" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "used_times" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "color" TEXT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "extra_info" TEXT NULL, "loan_info" TEXT NULL, "credit_info" TEXT NULL, "fixed_deposit_info" TEXT NULL, "group_name" TEXT NULL, "currency" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bank_card" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "card_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "card_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_no" TEXT NOT NULL, "card_owner" TEXT NOT NULL, "remark" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "card_color" TEXT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "create_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "card_asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "budget" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "budget_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "record_cat_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "section" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "create_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remark" TEXT NULL, "extra_info" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_platform" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "import_record_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "import_category_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "import_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "record" ("record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sub_type" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "money_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remark" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "record_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "record_cat_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "from_asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "to_asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "account_book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exclude_budget" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_budget" IN (0, 1)), "exclude_ex_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_ex_in" IN (0, 1)), "platform_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "period_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "installment" TEXT NULL, "images" TEXT NULL, "rel_info" TEXT NULL, "discount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "extra_info" TEXT NULL, "create_date" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("record_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "record_category" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "parent_cat_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "color_fill" TEXT NULL, "platform_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "account_book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_hide" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_hide" IN (0, 1)), "extra_info" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "remark" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_cat_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "used_times" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "record_template" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remark" TEXT NULL, "money_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fee_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "record_cat_id" INTEGER NULL, "asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "asset_id2" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "auto_save" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_save" IN (0, 1)), "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exclude_budget" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_budget" IN (0, 1)), "exclude_ex_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_ex_in" IN (0, 1)), "create_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tags" TEXT NULL, "exi" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wish" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "create_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_realized" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_realized" IN (0, 1)), "realized_date" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "icon" TEXT NULL, "target_date" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "record_period" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "record_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "money_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fee_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "remark" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "cat_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "asset_id2" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "images" TEXT NULL, "state" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "time" TEXT NULL, "exclude_budget" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_budget" IN (0, 1)), "exclude_ex_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_ex_in" IN (0, 1)), "period_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period_type_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period_end_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "frequency" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_add_date" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "period_add_times" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "create_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tags" TEXT NULL, "exi" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminder_event" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "reminder_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reminder_tip" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installment" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "cat_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "principal_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "periods" INTEGER NOT NULL, "charge_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "charge_way" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remainder_in" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cal_way" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_period" INTEGER NOT NULL, "next_period_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "credited" TEXT NULL, "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "exclude_budget" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_budget" IN (0, 1)), "exclude_ex_in" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_ex_in" IN (0, 1)), "create_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tags" TEXT NULL, "images" TEXT NULL, "exi" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "create_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "update_time" INTEGER NOT NULL, "trash_time" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tag" ("tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), "parent_tag_id" TEXT NULL, "parent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "color" TEXT NULL, "extra_info" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("tag_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tag_record" ("tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("tag_id", "record_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "money_save_plan" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "remark" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "plan_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cycle_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plan_money_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "saved_money_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "auto_plan" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_plan" IN (0, 1)), "from_asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "to_asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "start_money_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "incremental_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "create_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_save_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "bbz_daily_times" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "icon" TEXT NULL, "extra_info" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "money_save_plan_record" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remark" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "from_asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "to_asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT -1, "record_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "record_money_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_book" ("asset_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id", "book_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stat_story" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "story" TEXT NOT NULL, "book_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sdate" INTEGER NOT NULL, "edate" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dsection" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "auto_map" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "map_info" TEXT NULL, "draft" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "currency" ("code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "rate_to_anchor" TEXT NOT NULL, "anchor_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_refresh_time" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "icon" TEXT NULL, "enable" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enable" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("code"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ti_write_command" ("command_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "result_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "committed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("command_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ti_preference" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX index_budget_record_cat_id ON budget (record_cat_id)
CREATE INDEX index_record_account_book_id ON record (account_book_id)
CREATE INDEX record_book_time ON record (account_book_id, record_time DESC)
CREATE INDEX record_asset ON record (asset_id)
CREATE INDEX record_from_asset ON record (from_asset_id)
CREATE INDEX record_to_asset ON record (to_asset_id)
CREATE INDEX record_category_book_parent ON record_category (account_book_id, parent_cat_id, sort)
CREATE INDEX index_tag_record_record_id ON tag_record (record_id)
